claim: The game's own folders hold no log file. The per-user folder %LOCALAPPDATA%/WB Games/Shadow of War holds the saves (<uid>_ShadowOfWar.sav and <uid>_<n>_ShadowOfWar.sav, under two uids: one from the earlier Steam install, one the GOG copy wrote at the owner's launch test), render.cfg, gpu.nfo and a CloudStorage folder of 10 WB promotional files tagged '-stm', last written 2026-10-23/24 (before the GOG install). The GOG install has only 'game' and 'x64' folders; its config- or log-like files are store and installer metadata (goggame-*.info, goglog.ini, unins*), EULA.txt, and game/projectconsole.cfg and game/SKU.cfg. Documents/WB Games holds only Shadow of Mordor's settings (another game).
evidence: A metadata-only listing (names, sizes, modification times; no file opened) approved by the owner in chat on 2026-10-27, run by Claude Code with a scratch script. The GOG install was found through GOG's registry entry (check_gog_build.registry_path). The uids (a machine name and an 8-hex-digit id) are deliberately not recorded.
game_build_compatibility: GOG set pinned by D-008 (amended): exe SHA-256 F16DC9492E0F31565071936A652252C80CA32EB6E9C07C331AE89BDD9C3DE5D8 (FileVersion 1.0.2445.0). The per-user folder is shared with the earlier Steam install.
verification_method: Directory listing with os.walk and stat only, 2026-10-27, after the owner's launch test (F-ENV-013) and before any M1 session.
limitations: A listing at one moment, after a short launch test. The game may create other files during longer play or in folders not listed (the listing covered the per-user folder, Documents/WB Games and the install's config- and log-like files). File contents were not read: whether any permitted file holds the player position is EXP-048's question.
next_experiment: EXP-048 (M1 tier A sessions), after the owner's approval.
